title: Woman on Lake in Mexico, 1940s B&W Snapshot Portrait
description: A square vintage black and white snapshot photo from the 1940s capturing a woman seated outdoors on a boat, with a body of water and distant shoreline behind her. She wears a structured plaid blazer or jacket over a patterned top, with windswept hair. The back of the photo includes a handwritten note in ink reading 'Mother in Mexico'.
